text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Li~ke I said, who gives a crap about 
citric acid! You just wanna eat the 
chocolate flavor yourself!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, my, what harsh words. I was merely 
recommending the lemon flavor for fatigue 
recovery out of the sheer goodness of my 
heart...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, umm! How about rock-paper-scissors to 
keep things fair? Ah, I'm totally fine 
with whichever one is left over...!
choice_data_list: Is everything okay? Some kind of trouble?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... there is no need to worry... As you 
can see, they are merely squabbling over 
pudding...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Rock-paper-scissors is completely out of 
the question! It lacks even a shred of 
rationality. Listen closely: the one who 
requires polyphenols most right now is—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
SHUUUUT UUUUUP with your whining!! The 
chocolate flavor is MINE!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this... let's settle it 
with a run!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're taking it that far~?! Uuuh, do 
your best, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're running too! Cafe, you as well! 
That way nobody can complain. No backing 
out or holding back either!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
—What's this? A race? No way, with this 
lineup...?!
choice_data_list:
Whoa... more and more people are 
gathering...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! A head-to-head showdown! ...Well, 
obviously, the one taking the win is gonna 
be me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, bold words. Though I have yet to 
say I will participate...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Ooh! Look upon the stir among the masses! 
Is such a heart-stirring spectacle about 
to commence?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A mock race with everyone? Sounds 
wonderful... Um! If it's alright, I'd like 
to test my skills too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you two jumping in~? Then I would 
like to... j-join as well, pwease...!
choice_data_list:
S-Such an incredible lineup keeps 
assembling...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hah, got some guts, don'tcha. Still, with 
this many runners... the academy track's 
definitely packed right now...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hey, you. Give us a hand.

I agreed without thinking, simply because 
I genuinely wanted to see it. A race 
between them. And then, after school...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, this is awesome! What is this, a 
festival?! Not bad, trainer. Thanks a 
bunch!
choice_data_list:
You're welcome! I'm expecting great 
things!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO~! Go get 'em~~! Pokke's gonna win! 
Pokke is the strongest! To think we get to 
watch a race like this...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Such amazing excitement. Pokke, 
give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, just watch me. I'm gonna claim 
both the title of the strongest... and!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That chocolate flavor!! I'm gonna taste 
what victory is all about!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—Phew~, made it in time...! So many 
people...! We only called for this at 
lunch, and it's already like this? That's 
Pokke-chan's power for you.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... all this over a single cup of 
pudding... Still, yeah... this incredible 
excitement...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I don't... want to lose either! I'll give 
it my all...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, me as well... Since I am 
participating, I intend to win... 
...However, surely that person will not...

Ever since we started planning the race, 
she was the only one who didn't give a 
clear answer. It's a shame... or so I 
thought, until—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Quite lively, isn't it. Is that so-called 
"taste of victory" truly so sweet, I 
wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ...! Tachyon-san. ...! Tachyon-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Tachyon. So you didn't run away after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I heard the turnout was far greater than 
expected. What better opportunity to 
observe the psychological effects of 
environment and roaring cheers?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Your passion moved everyone around you. 
...I suppose I, too, am merely one of 
those results.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? As usual, I got no clue what the hell 
you're talking about.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In short... unless I actually win and 
claim the chocolate flavor, I cannot 
properly verify it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This "taste of victory" of yours, that is—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ............Hah! Bring it on!

—And so, the race began. The sound of the 
gates opening always echoes into the sky 
alongside a solemn tension...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOAAAAAHHHHHHHH----!! The strongest 
is ME----!!
